description: This file contains utility functions for validating the structural integrity of UnsafeRow objects in Apache Spark, including schema consistency checks, offset and size validations for variable-length fields, and methods to determine null handling and binary stability.

classes.name: UnsafeRowUtils
classes.description: Object providing utility methods for validating and inspecting UnsafeRow objects in Spark SQL.

methods.name: validateStructuralIntegrityWithReasonImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of an UnsafeRow against an expected schema, checking field counts, offsets, sizes, and nullability constraints, returning an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: validateStructuralIntegrityWithReason
methods.description: Wrapper around validateStructuralIntegrityWithReasonImpl that adds debugging information and status details.

methods.name: getOffsetAndSize
methods.description: Extracts the offset and size of a variable-length field from an UnsafeRow at a given index.

methods.name: avoidSetNullAt
methods.description: Determines if calling setNullAt on a field of a specific DataType should be avoided due to in-place update constraints.

methods.name: getStructuralIntegrityStatus
methods.description: Generates a string report on the structural integrity status of an UnsafeRow compared to an expected schema.

methods.name: isBinaryStable
methods.description: Checks if a DataType supports binary equality comparison, meaning binary representations can be used for equality and hashing.
